findings.text: follow-on: the read-only SQLite URI is built by string interpolation (f"file:{Path(index)}?mode=ro") without URL-quoting the path, so a cache root containing a space, "?", or "#" yields a malformed URI and returns None, misclassifying a live index as unrecorded (Path.as_uri() or urllib.parse.quote would keep it exact).
